text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Valentine's Day, and Agnes Digital has arrived, gingerly holding a pack of chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer! So, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Today, we give praise for the beautiful ships in our lives—and you would not believe the amount of love I poured into these Valentine's chocolates!
choice_data_list: Who are you giving them to?
Who are you giving them to?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: We are offering them to my shrine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She genuinely isn't giving them to anyone. Agnes Digital sets up a merch shine in my office and lays down her offerings…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Bon appétit, my Umamusume. Eat to your heart's content in my imagination…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Even though they aren't eating my chocolate for real, I can still picture the look on their faces… Mmm-mmm-mmm…
choice_data_list: Why not give chocolate to the racers themselves?
Why not give chocolate to the racers themselves?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: U-unthinkable! I can't give to my idols!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let's say that I did. That would be making myself noticeable to them, and they might even feel obligated to give me something in return.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Not to mention how egotistical it is to presume that my feelings are worth communicating to them at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Simping should be done from afar, so I merely look respectfully and celebrate discreetly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital doesn't want to draw attention from those she worships, so I suppose this alternative is all right.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All righty, Trainer. I've finished my prayer, so let's eat up!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Of course. Now that we've finished making our offering, stage two is where we eat the chocolates and discuss how precious our oshis are.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mmm, I am truly blessed. I never thought fate would bring me a companion I can share my love of Umas with!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay, now, don't hold back today—open up your heart and spill everything. Tell me… who's your favorite oshi these days?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll tell you mine. Recently, I just absolutely can't stop thinking about…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mmm… Gaaahh… Actually, there's no way I can choose! There are too many!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital swoons in ecstasy as we indulge in chocolates and chatter about Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure "oshi" is the correct way to put it, but as her trainer…
choice_data_list: Here, I've got some chocolate for you.
Here, I've got some chocolate for you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? Chocolate for… me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …Wait, WHAAAT?! CHOCOLAAATE?! FOR MEEE?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-what?! This is kinda out of nowhere! Why are you putting me up on a pedestal like this?!
choice_data_list: Enjoy and keep up the good work!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is this all-encompassing love? Every Valentine's Day, I'm just a plebeian spectator… Do you really want to cheer me on?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But who else would simp for an Umamusume as niche as me? I knew you were a die-hard Uma fan! A simp after my own heart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You're the model otaku! Today, you've given me something even more important than chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I can get through the next five or even ten Valentine's if you're with me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So, let's continue offering up our love to Umas together. Let's swear it on the shrine… t-together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At Agnes Digital's insistence, I vow to support her and her faves moving forward.
